briefdescription.para: Targeted regression tests for Wave-A AN1 and AN2 hardening gaps.

sect2.title: Test families

para.heading: AN1 — Federated query coordinator: shard-level retry

sect2.para: AN1-01 Single shard retried on transient failure; succeeds on second call AN1-02 Shard counted as failed only after max_retries exhausted AN1-03 Positive backoff delay between retry attempts (mock timer) AN1-04 Permanent failure (invalid query) does NOT trigger a retry

AN2-01 Model with correct checksum deserializes successfully AN2-02 Model with corrupted checksum throws / returns error AN2-03 Model without checksum passes with WARN (no hard fail) AN2-04 Checksum is stored at save time and is verifiable on reload
